attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra

private theorem probeAlgebraEqOfSelfTower (k : Type u) [Field k]
    {B : Type u} [CommRing B] (iT iD : Algebra k B)
    (tw : @IsScalarTower k k B (Algebra.id k).toSMul iT.toSMul iD.toSMul) :
    iD = iT := by
  refine Algebra.algebra_ext _ _ fun r => ?_
  rw [@IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k k B _ _ _ (Algebra.id k) iT iD tw]
  rfl

theorem probeSectionsAlgebraMapSelfEq (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : T.left.Opens) :
    Over.sectionsAlgebra
        ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k)))).obj T) U =
      Over.sectionsAlgebra T U := by
  exact probeAlgebraEqOfSelfTower k
    (Over.sectionsAlgebra T U)
    (Over.sectionsAlgebra
      ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k)))).obj T) U)
    (Over.isScalarTower_sections_map k k T U)

theorem probeFamilyHomEq (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom]
    [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] :
    ∀ (B : Type u) [CommRing B]
      [iD : Algebra k B] [iE : Algebra k B] [iT : Algebra k B]
      [twD : @IsScalarTower k k B (Algebra.id k).toSMul iT.toSMul iD.toSMul]
      [twE : @IsScalarTower k k B (Algebra.id k).toSMul iT.toSMul iE.toSMul],
      @RelPicTransportFamily.hom k k _ _ k _ (Algebra.id k) (Algebra.id k)
          C ((baseChange k k).obj C) (crossBaseTransportFamilyInv k k C)
          B _ iD iE iT twD twE =
        @RelPicTransportFamily.hom k k _ _ k _ (Algebra.id k) (Algebra.id k)
          C ((baseChange k k).obj C)
          (curveTransportFamily ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv)
          B _ iD iE iT twD twE := by
  intro B _ iD iE iT twD twE
  obtain rfl : iE = iD :=
    (probeAlgebraEqOfSelfTower k iT iE twE).trans
      (probeAlgebraEqOfSelfTower k iT iD twD).symm
  obtain rfl : iE = iT := probeAlgebraEqOfSelfTower k iT iE twE
  rw [crossBaseTransportFamilyInv_hom, curveTransportFamily_hom,
    crossBaseAffineIso_inv_eq_whiskerRight]
  rfl

private theorem probeCurveMixedEqMapAlg (k : Type u) [Field k]
    {D E : Over (Spec (.of k))} (g : D ⟶ E)
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (iD iE : Algebra k A) (hDE : iD = iE)
    (twD : @IsScalarTower k k A (Algebra.id k).toSMul iE.toSMul iD.toSMul)
    (twE : @IsScalarTower k k A (Algebra.id k).toSMul iE.toSMul iE.toSMul)
    (φ : @AlgHom k A A _ _ _ iE iD) (hφ : ∀ a, φ a = a)
    (a : @PicEtAff k _ E A _ iE) :
    @RelPicTransportFamily.picEtAffHom k k _ _ k _ (Algebra.id k) (Algebra.id k)
        D E (curveTransportFamily g) A _ iD iE iE twD twE a =
      @PicEtAff.mapAlg k _ D A _ iE A _ iD φ
        (@PicEtAff.curveMap k _ D E A _ iE g a) := by
  cases hDE
  have hφ' : φ = AlgHom.id k A := AlgHom.ext fun x => hφ x
  subst φ
  rw [PicEtAff.mapAlg_id]
  rfl

section AffineProbe

variable (k : Type u) [Field k]
variable (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

noncomputable def probeMId :
    Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k))) ≅
      𝟭 (Over (Spec (.of k))) :=
  let σ := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k))
  have hσ : σ = 𝟙 (Spec (.of k)) := by
    dsimp [σ]
    simp
  NatIso.ofComponents (fun T => Over.isoMk (Iso.refl T.left) (by
    exact (Category.id_comp T.hom).trans
      ((congrArg (fun q => T.hom ≫ q) hσ).trans (Category.comp_id T.hom)).symm)) (fun f => by
      apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
      simp)

@[simp]
theorem probeMId_hom_app_left (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) :
    ((probeMId k).hom.app T).left = 𝟙 T.left := by
  simp [probeMId]

set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
theorem probeAffineBridge (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (W : T.left.affineOpens)
    (hW : W.1 ≤ ((probeMId k).hom.app T).left ⁻¹ᵁ W.1)
    (a : PicEtAff ((baseChange k k).obj C) Γ(T.left, W.1)) :
    (sectionShuffle k k C T W.1).symm a =
      PicEtAff.mapAlg C
        (Over.appLEAlgHom ((probeMId k).hom.app T) W.1 W.1 hW)
        (PicEtAff.curveMap Γ(T.left, W.1) ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv a) := by
  let iD := Over.sectionsAlgebra
    ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k)))).obj T) W.1
  let iE := Over.sectionsAlgebra T W.1
  let twD : @IsScalarTower k k Γ(T.left, W.1) (Algebra.id k).toSMul
      iE.toSMul iD.toSMul := Over.isScalarTower_sections_map k k T W.1
  let twE : @IsScalarTower k k Γ(T.left, W.1) (Algebra.id k).toSMul
      iE.toSMul iE.toSMul := .of_algebraMap_eq fun _ => rfl
  change @RelPicTransportFamily.picEtAffHom k k _ _ k _ (Algebra.id k) (Algebra.id k)
      C ((baseChange k k).obj C) (crossBaseTransportFamilyInv k k C)
        Γ(T.left, W.1) _ iD iE iE twD twE a =
    @PicEtAff.mapAlg k _ C Γ(T.left, W.1) _ iE Γ(T.left, W.1) _ iD
      (Over.appLEAlgHom ((probeMId k).hom.app T) W.1 W.1 hW)
      (@PicEtAff.curveMap k _ C ((baseChange k k).obj C) Γ(T.left, W.1) _ iE
        ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv a)
  calc
    _ = @RelPicTransportFamily.picEtAffHom k k _ _ k _ (Algebra.id k) (Algebra.id k)
        C ((baseChange k k).obj C)
        (curveTransportFamily ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv)
        Γ(T.left, W.1) _ iD iE iE twD twE a := by
      exact @RelPicTransportFamily.picEtAffHom_congr k k k _ _ _
        (Algebra.id k) (Algebra.id k) C ((baseChange k k).obj C)
        (crossBaseTransportFamilyInv k k C)
        (curveTransportFamily ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv)
        (probeFamilyHomEq k C) Γ(T.left, W.1) _ iD iE iE twD twE a
    _ = _ := by
      refine probeCurveMixedEqMapAlg k ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv iD iE
        (probeSectionsAlgebraMapSelfEq k T W.1) twD twE _ ?_ a
      intro s
      change ((probeMId k).hom.app T).left.appLE W.1 W.1 hW s = s
      rw [Scheme.Hom.appLE_congr_hom (probeMId_hom_app_left k T) W.1 W.1 hW le_rfl]
      change Over.resAlgHom
        ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k)))).obj T)
          (show W.1 ≤ W.1 from le_rfl) s = s
      rw [Over.resAlgHom_rfl]
      rfl

set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
-- Each affine value is compared before extensionality assembles the compatible family.
theorem probePicEtIdentity (T : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    (lam : pic0Subgroup ((baseChange k k).obj C) T) :
    picEtCrossBaseInv k k C T lam.1 =
      picEtMap C ((probeMId k).hom.app T)
        (picEtPullback ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv T lam.1) := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext W
  have hW : W.1 ≤ ((probeMId k).hom.app T).left ⁻¹ᵁ W.1 := by
    rw [probeMId_hom_app_left]
    exact le_rfl
  calc
    (picEtCrossBaseInv k k C T lam.1).1 W =
        (sectionShuffle k k C T W.1).symm (lam.1.1 ⟨W.1, W.2⟩) :=
      picEtCrossBaseInv_val k k C T lam.1 W
    _ = PicEtAff.mapAlg C
        (Over.appLEAlgHom ((probeMId k).hom.app T) W.1 W.1 hW)
        (PicEtAff.curveMap Γ(T.left, W.1) ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv
          (lam.1.1 ⟨W.1, W.2⟩)) :=
      probeAffineBridge k C T W hW _
    _ = PicEtAff.mapAlg C
        (Over.appLEAlgHom ((probeMId k).hom.app T) W.1 W.1 hW)
        ((picEtPullback ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv T lam.1).1 W) :=
      congrArg (PicEtAff.mapAlg C
        (Over.appLEAlgHom ((probeMId k).hom.app T) W.1 W.1 hW))
        (picEtPullback_val ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv T lam.1 W).symm
    _ = picEtMapVal C ((probeMId k).hom.app T)
        (picEtPullback ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv T lam.1) W :=
      (picEtMapVal_eq_mapAlg C ((probeMId k).hom.app T)
        (picEtPullback ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv T lam.1)
        (W := W) (V := W) hW).symm
    _ = (picEtMap C ((probeMId k).hom.app T)
        (picEtPullback ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv T lam.1)).1 W :=
      (picEtMap_val C ((probeMId k).hom.app T)
        (picEtPullback ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv T lam.1) W).symm

end AffineProbe

noncomputable def probeMId :

    exact (Category.id_comp T.hom).trans

      apply Over.OverMorphism.ext

@[simp]
theorem probeMId_hom_app_left (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) :
    ((probeMId k).hom.app T).left = 𝟙 T.left := by
  simp [probeMId]

theorem probeSectionsAlgebraMapSelfEq
    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : T.left.Opens) :
    Over.sectionsAlgebra
        ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k)))).obj T) U =
      Over.sectionsAlgebra T U := by
  let iD := Over.sectionsAlgebra
    ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k)))).obj T) U
  let iT := Over.sectionsAlgebra T U
  change iD = iT
  have tw : @IsScalarTower k k Γ(T.left, U) (Algebra.id k).toSMul
      iT.toSMul iD.toSMul := Over.isScalarTower_sections_map k k T U
  have hi := @IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k k Γ(T.left, U) _ _ _
    (Algebra.id k) iT iD tw
  exact Algebra.algebra_ext iD iT fun r =>
    (DFunLike.congr_fun hi r).trans (by rfl)

theorem probeAlgebraEqOfTower {B : Type u} [CommRing B]
    (iT iD : Algebra k B)
    (tw : @IsScalarTower k k B (Algebra.id k).toSMul iT.toSMul iD.toSMul) :
    iD = iT := by
  have hiMap := @IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k k B _ _ _
    (Algebra.id k) iT iD tw
  exact Algebra.algebra_ext iD iT fun r =>
    (DFunLike.congr_fun hiMap r).trans (by rfl)

theorem probeFamilyHomEq :
    ∀ (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra k B]
      [IsScalarTower k k B] [IsScalarTower k k B],
      (crossBaseTransportFamilyInv k k C).hom B =
        (curveTransportFamily ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv).hom B := by
  intro B _ iD iE iT twD twE
  dsimp only [crossBaseTransportFamilyInv, curveTransportFamily]
  exact crossBaseAffineIso_inv_eq_whiskerRight k C B

theorem probeMixedCurveMapAlg {D E : Over (Spec (.of k))} (g : D ⟶ E)
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (iD iE : Algebra k A)
    (twD : @IsScalarTower k k A (Algebra.id k).toSMul iE.toSMul iD.toSMul)
    (twE : @IsScalarTower k k A (Algebra.id k).toSMul iE.toSMul iE.toSMul)
    (φ : @AlgHom k A A _ _ _ iE iD) (hφ : ∀ a, φ a = a)
    (a : @PicEtAff k _ E A _ iE) :
    (@RelPicTransportFamily.picEtAffHom k k _ _ k _ (Algebra.id k) (Algebra.id k)
      D E (curveTransportFamily g) A _ iD iE iE twD twE) a =
      (@PicEtAff.mapAlg k _ D A _ iE A _ iD φ)
        ((@PicEtAff.curveMap k _ D E A _ iE g) a) := by
  have hiMap := @IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k k A _ _ _
    (Algebra.id k) iE iD twD
  have hi : iD = iE := Algebra.algebra_ext iD iE fun r =>
    (DFunLike.congr_fun hiMap r).trans (by rfl)
  subst iD
  have hφ' : φ = AlgHom.id k A := AlgHom.ext hφ
  subst φ
  rw [PicEtAff.mapAlg_id]
  rfl

theorem probeMixedCrossBaseMapAlg (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    (iD iE : Algebra k A)
    (twD : @IsScalarTower k k A (Algebra.id k).toSMul iE.toSMul iD.toSMul)
    (twE : @IsScalarTower k k A (Algebra.id k).toSMul iE.toSMul iE.toSMul)
    (φ : @AlgHom k A A _ _ _ iE iD) (hφ : ∀ a, φ a = a)
    (a : @PicEtAff k _ ((baseChange k k).obj C) A _ iE) :
    (@RelPicTransportFamily.picEtAffHom k k _ _ k _ (Algebra.id k) (Algebra.id k)
      C ((baseChange k k).obj C) (crossBaseTransportFamilyInv k k C)
      A _ iD iE iE twD twE) a =
      (@PicEtAff.mapAlg k _ C A _ iE A _ iD φ)
        ((@PicEtAff.curveMap k _ C ((baseChange k k).obj C) A _ iE
          ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv) a) := by
  calc
    _ = (@RelPicTransportFamily.picEtAffHom k k _ _ k _
        (Algebra.id k) (Algebra.id k) C ((baseChange k k).obj C)
        (curveTransportFamily ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv)
        A _ iD iE iE twD twE) a :=
      @RelPicTransportFamily.picEtAffHom_congr k k k _ _ _
        (Algebra.id k) (Algebra.id k) C ((baseChange k k).obj C)
        (crossBaseTransportFamilyInv k k C)
        (curveTransportFamily ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv)
        (fun B _ iDB iEB iTB twDB twEB => by
          obtain rfl : iTB = iDB := (probeAlgebraEqOfTower k iTB iDB twDB).symm
          obtain rfl : iTB = iEB := (probeAlgebraEqOfTower k iTB iEB twEB).symm
          dsimp only [crossBaseTransportFamilyInv, curveTransportFamily]
          exact crossBaseAffineIso_inv_eq_whiskerRight k C B)
        A _ iD iE iE twD twE a
    _ = _ := probeMixedCurveMapAlg k ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv
      A iD iE twD twE φ hφ a

theorem probeSectionShuffleSymmTransport (T : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    (U : T.left.Opens)
    (a : PicEtAff ((baseChange k k).obj C) Γ(T.left, U)) :
    (sectionShuffle k k C T U).symm a =
      let iD := Over.sectionsAlgebra
        ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k)))).obj T) U
      let iE := Over.sectionsAlgebra T U
      let twD : @IsScalarTower k k Γ(T.left, U)
          (Algebra.id k).toSMul iE.toSMul iD.toSMul :=
        Over.isScalarTower_sections_map k k T U
      let twE : @IsScalarTower k k Γ(T.left, U)
          (Algebra.id k).toSMul iE.toSMul iE.toSMul :=
        @IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq k k Γ(T.left, U) _ _ _
          (Algebra.id k) iE iE (fun _ => rfl)
      (@RelPicTransportFamily.picEtAffHom k k _ _ k _
        (Algebra.id k) (Algebra.id k) C ((baseChange k k).obj C)
        (crossBaseTransportFamilyInv k k C) Γ(T.left, U) _
        iD iE iE twD twE) a := by

set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
theorem probe_map_goal
    (T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ)
    (lam : pic0Subgroup ((baseChange k k).obj C) T.unop) :
    picEtCrossBaseInv k k C T.unop lam.1 =
      picEtMap C ((probeMId k).hom.app T.unop)
        (picEtPullback ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv T.unop lam.1) := by
  refine picEt.ext fun W => ?_
  rw [picEtCrossBaseInv_val, picEtMap_val]
  have hW : W.1 ≤ ((probeMId k).hom.app T.unop).left ⁻¹ᵁ W.1 := by
    rw [probeMId_hom_app_left]
    exact le_rfl
  calc
    (sectionShuffle k k C T.unop W.1).symm (lam.1.1 ⟨W.1, W.2⟩) =
        PicEtAff.mapAlg C
          (Over.appLEAlgHom ((probeMId k).hom.app T.unop) W.1 W.1 hW)
          ((picEtPullback ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv T.unop lam.1).1 W) := by
      rw [picEtPullback_val, probeSectionShuffleSymmTransport]
      dsimp only
      let iD := Over.sectionsAlgebra
        ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k)))).obj T.unop) W.1
      let iE := Over.sectionsAlgebra T.unop W.1
      have twD : @IsScalarTower k k Γ(T.unop.left, W.1)
          (Algebra.id k).toSMul iE.toSMul iD.toSMul :=
        Over.isScalarTower_sections_map k k T.unop W.1
      have twE : @IsScalarTower k k Γ(T.unop.left, W.1)
          (Algebra.id k).toSMul iE.toSMul iE.toSMul :=
        @IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq k k Γ(T.unop.left, W.1) _ _ _
          (Algebra.id k) iE iE (fun _ => rfl)
      let φ : @AlgHom k Γ(T.unop.left, W.1) Γ(T.unop.left, W.1)
          _ _ _ iE iD :=
        Over.appLEAlgHom ((probeMId k).hom.app T.unop) W.1 W.1 hW
      have hφ : ∀ s, φ s = s := by
        intro s
        change ((probeMId k).hom.app T.unop).left.appLE W.1 W.1 hW s = s
        rw [Scheme.Hom.appLE_congr_hom (probeMId_hom_app_left k T.unop)
          W.1 W.1 hW le_rfl]
        rw [Scheme.Hom.appLE, Scheme.Hom.id_app]
        have he : (homOfLE (le_rfl : W.1 ≤ W.1)).op = 𝟙 _ := rfl
        rw [he, Functor.map_id, Category.comp_id]
        rfl
      exact probeMixedCrossBaseMapAlg k C _ iD iE twD twE φ hφ _
    _ = picEtMapVal C ((probeMId k).hom.app T.unop)
          (picEtPullback ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv T.unop lam.1) W :=
      by sorry

theorem probe_picEtAffHom_congr {kD kE kT : Type u}
    [Field kD] [Field kE] [Field kT] [Algebra kD kT] [Algebra kE kT]
    {D : Over (Spec (.of kD))} {E : Over (Spec (.of kE))}
    (S T : RelPicTransportFamily kT D E)
    (h : ∀ (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra kD B] [Algebra kE B] [Algebra kT B]
      [IsScalarTower kD kT B] [IsScalarTower kE kT B], S.hom B = T.hom B)
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra kD A] [Algebra kE A] [Algebra kT A]
    [IsScalarTower kD kT A] [IsScalarTower kE kT A] (a : PicEtAff E A) :
    S.picEtAffHom A a = T.picEtAffHom A a := by
  induction a using PicEtAff.ind with
  | _ U x =>
    rw [RelPicTransportFamily.picEtAffHom_mk, RelPicTransportFamily.picEtAffHom_mk]
    refine congrArg (PicEtAff.mk D U) (Subtype.ext ?_)
    rw [RelPicTransportFamily.descentHom_coe, RelPicTransportFamily.descentHom_coe]
    generalize (x : relPic E (overSpec kE U.Carrier)) = y
    induction y using relPic.ind with
    | mk L =>
      rw [RelPicTransportFamily.relPicHom_mk, RelPicTransportFamily.relPicHom_mk, h]

theorem probe_pullbackId_hom_app_left.{w} {D : Type w} [Category.{u} D]
    [HasPullbacks D] {S : D} (X : Over S) :
    (Over.pullbackId.hom.app X).left = pullback.fst X.hom (𝟙 S) := by
  simp [Over.pullbackId]

open Limits in
private theorem probe_pullback_fst_congr_left.{w} {D : Type w} [Category.{u} D]
    {W S T : D} (a : W ⟶ S) {f g : T ⟶ S} (hfg : f = g)
    [HasPullback a f] [HasPullback a g]
    (heq : Limits.pullback a f = Limits.pullback a g) :
    eqToHom heq ≫ pullback.fst a g = pullback.fst a f := by
  subst hfg
  exact Category.id_comp _

theorem probe_baseChange_idIso_hom_app_left (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) :
    ((baseChange.idIso k).hom.app C).left =
      pullback.fst C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k))) := by
  have hσ : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k)) = 𝟙 (Spec (.of k)) := by
    rw [Algebra.algebraMap_self, CommRingCat.ofHom_id, Spec.map_id]
  simp only [baseChange.idIso, Iso.trans_hom, NatTrans.comp_app, Over.comp_left,
    eqToIso.hom, eqToHom_app, probe_pullbackId_hom_app_left, Over.eqToHom_left]
  exact probe_pullback_fst_congr_left C.hom hσ _

open MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory in
theorem probe_crossBaseAffineIso_inv_whiskerRight_snd (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] :
    (((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv ▷ overSpec k B).left
        ≫ (Limits.snd ((baseChange k k).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left =
      (crossBaseAffineIso k k C B).inv
        ≫ (Limits.snd ((baseChange k k).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left :=
  Eq.trans
    (congrArg Over.Hom.left
      (MonoidalCategory.whiskerRight_snd (((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv)
        (overSpec k B)))
    (crossBaseAffineIso_inv_snd k k C B).symm

open MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory in
theorem probe_crossBaseAffineIso_inv_whiskerRight_fst (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] :
    (((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv ▷ overSpec k B).left
        ≫ (Limits.fst ((baseChange k k).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left =
      (crossBaseAffineIso k k C B).inv
        ≫ (Limits.fst ((baseChange k k).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left := by
  haveI : IsIso
      (pullback.fst C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k)))) := by
    rw [← probe_baseChange_idIso_hom_app_left k C]
    infer_instance
  rw [← cancel_mono
    (pullback.fst C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k))))]
  simp [crossBaseAffineIso, probe_baseChange_idIso_hom_app_left]

open MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory in
theorem probe_crossBaseAffineIso_inv_eq_whiskerRight (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] :
    (crossBaseAffineIso k k C B).inv =
      (((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv ▷ overSpec k B).left := by
  apply (Over.isPullback_left ((baseChange k k).obj C) (overSpec k B)).hom_ext
  · exact (probe_crossBaseAffineIso_inv_whiskerRight_fst k C B).symm
  · exact (probe_crossBaseAffineIso_inv_whiskerRight_snd k C B).symm

section Identity

variable (k : Type u) [Field k]
variable (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

noncomputable def probe_eCurveId :
    pic0Functor ((baseChange k k).obj C) ≅ pic0Functor C where
  hom := pic0PullbackNat ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv
  inv := pic0PullbackNat ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).hom
  hom_inv_id := by rw [← pic0PullbackNat_comp, Iso.hom_inv_id, pic0PullbackNat_id]
  inv_hom_id := by rw [← pic0PullbackNat_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id, pic0PullbackNat_id]

noncomputable def probe_mIdσ :
    Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k))) ≅
      𝟙 (Over (Spec (.of k))) :=
  eqToIso (by rw [show Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k)) = 𝟙 _ by
    rw [Algebra.algebraMap_self, CommRingCat.ofHom_id, Spec.map_id]]) ≪≅≫ Over.mapId _

noncomputable def probe_σkkCollapse :
    (Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k)))).op ⋙ pic0Functor C
      ≅ pic0Functor C :=
  Functor.isoWhiskerRight (NatIso.op (probe_mIdσ k)).symm (pic0Functor C)
    ≪≅≫ Functor.leftUnitor (pic0Functor C)

noncomputable def probe_cocycleIdRHS :
    pic0Functor ((baseChange k k).obj C) ≅
      (Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k)))).op ⋙
        pic0Functor C :=
  probe_eCurveId k C ≪≅≫ (probe_σkkCollapse k C).symm

theorem probe_pic0Theta_id : pic0Theta k k C = probe_cocycleIdRHS k C := by
  apply Iso.ext
  ext T lam
  refine Subtype.ext ?_
  change picEtCrossBaseInv k k C (Opposite.unop T) lam.1 =
    picEtMap C ((probe_mIdσ k).hom.app (Opposite.unop T))
      (picEtPullback ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv (Opposite.unop T) lam.1)
  have hf : (probe_mIdσ k).hom.app (Opposite.unop T) = 𝟙 _ := by
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    simp [probe_mIdσ, Over.mapId]
  rw [hf, picEtMap_id]
  refine picEt.ext fun W => ?_
  rw [picEtCrossBaseInv_val, picEtPullback_val]
  change (crossBaseTransportFamilyInv k k C).picEtAffHom _ _ =
    (curveTransportFamily ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv).picEtAffHom _ _
  exact probe_picEtAffHom_congr _ _ (fun B _ _ _ _ _ _ => by
    rw [crossBaseTransportFamilyInv_hom, curveTransportFamily_hom,
      probe_crossBaseAffineIso_inv_eq_whiskerRight]) _ _

end Identity

variable {K : Type u} [Field K] {Y : Scheme.{u}} [Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]

/-- The inverse coordinate restricted to the overlap. -/
noncomputable def overlapY (D : FiberCoordinateData Y) : Γ(Y, D.V₀ ⊓ D.V₁) :=
  (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : D.V₀ ⊓ D.V₁ ≤ D.V₁)).op).hom D.y

/-- The normalized two-chart differential `(a,b) ↦ y^n a - b`. -/
noncomputable def coordinateDiff (D : FiberCoordinateData Y) (n : ℕ) :
    (Γ(Y, D.V₀) × Γ(Y, D.V₁)) →ₗ[K] Γ(Y, D.V₀ ⊓ D.V₁) :=
  ((LinearMap.mul K Γ(Y, D.V₀ ⊓ D.V₁) (D.overlapY ^ n)).comp
      (((Y.moduleKSheaf K).obj.map
        (homOfLE (inf_le_left : D.V₀ ⊓ D.V₁ ≤ D.V₀)).op).hom.comp
          (LinearMap.fst K _ _))) -
    ((Y.moduleKSheaf K).obj.map
      (homOfLE (inf_le_right : D.V₀ ⊓ D.V₁ ≤ D.V₁)).op).hom.comp
        (LinearMap.snd K _ _)

lemma coordinateDiff_apply (D : FiberCoordinateData Y) (n : ℕ)
    (p : Γ(Y, D.V₀) × Γ(Y, D.V₁)) :
    D.coordinateDiff n p = D.overlapY ^ n *
        (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : D.V₀ ⊓ D.V₁ ≤ D.V₀)).op).hom p.1 -
      (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : D.V₀ ⊓ D.V₁ ≤ D.V₁)).op).hom p.2 :=
  rfl

section BaseChange

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))}
variable (kappa : Type u) [Field kappa] [Algebra k kappa]
variable (D : FiberCoordinateData C.left)

noncomputable def coordinateDiffDomBaseChangeField :
    kappa ⊗[k] (Γ(C.left, D.V₀) × Γ(C.left, D.V₁)) ≃ₗ[kappa]
      Γ((baseChangeField C kappa).left, (D.baseChangeField kappa).V₀) ×
        Γ((baseChangeField C kappa).left, (D.baseChangeField kappa).V₁) :=
  (TensorProduct.prodRight k kappa kappa _ _).trans
    ((sectionsBaseChangeFieldₗ kappa D.isAffineOpen_V₀.isCompact
        D.isAffineOpen_V₀.isQuasiSeparated).prodCongr
      (sectionsBaseChangeFieldₗ kappa D.isAffineOpen_V₁.isCompact
        D.isAffineOpen_V₁.isQuasiSeparated))

noncomputable def coordinateDiffCodBaseChangeField :
    kappa ⊗[k] Γ(C.left, D.V₀ ⊓ D.V₁) ≃ₗ[kappa]
      Γ((baseChangeField C kappa).left,
        (D.baseChangeField kappa).V₀ ⊓ (D.baseChangeField kappa).V₁) :=
  sectionsBaseChangeFieldₗ kappa
    ((D.toAffineCoverMVSquare).isAffineOpen_inf.isCompact)
    ((D.toAffineCoverMVSquare).isAffineOpen_inf.isQuasiSeparated)

lemma overlapY_baseChangeField :
    (D.baseChangeField kappa).overlapY =
      sectionsBaseChangeFieldₗ kappa
        ((D.toAffineCoverMVSquare).isAffineOpen_inf.isCompact)
        ((D.toAffineCoverMVSquare).isAffineOpen_inf.isQuasiSeparated)
        (1 ⊗ₜ D.overlapY) := by
  rw [sectionsBaseChangeFieldₗ_one_tmul]
  let f := baseChangeFieldFst C kappa
  have h := congrArg
    (fun g : Γ(C.left, D.V₁) ⟶
        Γ((baseChangeField C kappa).left, f ⁻¹ᵁ (D.V₀ ⊓ D.V₁)) => g.hom D.y)
    (f.naturality (homOfLE (inf_le_right : D.V₀ ⊓ D.V₁ ≤ D.V₁)).op)
  exact h.symm

theorem coordinateDiff_baseChangeField (n : ℕ) :
    ((D.baseChangeField kappa).coordinateDiff n).comp
        (coordinateDiffDomBaseChangeField kappa D).toLinearMap =
      (coordinateDiffCodBaseChangeField kappa D).toLinearMap.comp
        ((D.coordinateDiff n).baseChange kappa) := by
  ext x
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
  induction x with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
  | add u v hu hv => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, map_add, hu, hv]
  | tmul a p =>
    obtain ⟨s₀, s₁⟩ := p
    rw [LinearMap.baseChange_tmul]
    have hdom : coordinateDiffDomBaseChangeField kappa D (a ⊗ₜ (s₀, s₁)) =
        (sectionsBaseChangeFieldₗ kappa D.isAffineOpen_V₀.isCompact
            D.isAffineOpen_V₀.isQuasiSeparated (a ⊗ₜ s₀),
          sectionsBaseChangeFieldₗ kappa D.isAffineOpen_V₁.isCompact
            D.isAffineOpen_V₁.isQuasiSeparated (a ⊗ₜ s₁)) := rfl
    rw [hdom, coordinateDiff_apply, overlapY_baseChangeField]
    change _ = sectionsBaseChangeField kappa
      ((D.toAffineCoverMVSquare).isAffineOpen_inf.isCompact)
      ((D.toAffineCoverMVSquare).isAffineOpen_inf.isQuasiSeparated)
      ((D.coordinateDiff n (s₀, s₁)) ⊗ₜ a)
    rw [coordinateDiff_apply, sub_tmul, map_sub]
    have h₀ := sectionsBaseChangeField_res kappa D.isAffineOpen_V₀.isCompact
      D.isAffineOpen_V₀.isQuasiSeparated
      (D.toAffineCoverMVSquare).isAffineOpen_inf.isCompact
      (D.toAffineCoverMVSquare).isAffineOpen_inf.isQuasiSeparated inf_le_left s₀ a
    have h₁ := sectionsBaseChangeField_res kappa D.isAffineOpen_V₁.isCompact
      D.isAffineOpen_V₁.isQuasiSeparated
      (D.toAffineCoverMVSquare).isAffineOpen_inf.isCompact
      (D.toAffineCoverMVSquare).isAffineOpen_inf.isQuasiSeparated inf_le_right s₁ a
    rw [h₀, h₁]
    rw [mul_tmul, map_mul, map_pow]
    rfl

theorem coordinateDiff_baseChangeField_surjective (n : ℕ)
    (hd : Function.Surjective (D.coordinateDiff n)) :
    Function.Surjective ((D.baseChangeField kappa).coordinateDiff n) := by
  intro y
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := LinearMap.baseChange_surjective kappa hd
    ((coordinateDiffCodBaseChangeField kappa D).symm y)
  refine ⟨coordinateDiffDomBaseChangeField kappa D z, ?_⟩
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (coordinateDiff_baseChangeField kappa D n) z
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, hz,
    LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at h
  exact h

noncomputable def kerEquivOfComm
    {M N M' N' : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module kappa M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module kappa N] [AddCommGroup M'] [Module kappa M']
    [AddCommGroup N'] [Module kappa N']
    {f : M →ₗ[kappa] N} {g : M' →ₗ[kappa] N'}
    (e₀ : M ≃ₗ[kappa] M') (e₁ : N ≃ₗ[kappa] N')
    (h : g.comp e₀.toLinearMap = e₁.toLinearMap.comp f) :
    LinearMap.ker f ≃ₗ[kappa] LinearMap.ker g :=
  LinearEquiv.ofBijective
    (LinearMap.codRestrict (LinearMap.ker g)
      (e₀.toLinearMap.comp (LinearMap.ker f).subtype) (fun x => by
        rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
        have hx := LinearMap.congr_fun h x
        simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, x.2, map_zero] using hx))
    (by
      constructor
      · intro x y hxy
        apply Subtype.ext
        apply e₀.injective
        exact congrArg Subtype.val hxy
      · intro y
        have hy : f (e₀.symm y) = 0 := by
          apply e₁.injective
          have he := LinearMap.congr_fun h (e₀.symm y)
          simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
            LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, y.2, map_zero] using he.symm
        refine ⟨⟨e₀.symm y, hy⟩, ?_⟩
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact e₀.apply_symm_apply y)

noncomputable def coordinateDiffKerBaseChangeEquiv (n : ℕ)
    (hd : Function.Surjective (D.coordinateDiff n)) :
    kappa ⊗[k] LinearMap.ker (D.coordinateDiff n) ≃ₗ[kappa]
      LinearMap.ker ((D.baseChangeField kappa).coordinateDiff n) :=
  (LinearEquiv.ofBijective
    (AlgebraicJacobian.TwoTerm.kerBaseChange (D.coordinateDiff n) kappa)
    (AlgebraicJacobian.TwoTerm.bijective_kerBaseChange_of_surjective hd kappa)).trans
  (kerEquivOfComm (coordinateDiffDomBaseChangeField kappa D)
    (coordinateDiffCodBaseChangeField kappa D)
    (coordinateDiff_baseChangeField kappa D n))

variable {K : Type u} [Field K] {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral Y]
  [Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]

variable (D : FiberCoordinateData Y) (n : ℕ)

noncomputable def zeroSectionsEquiv (U : Y.Opens) :
    Γ(Y, U) ≃ₗ[K] divisorSections K 0 U :=
  LinearEquiv.ofBijective (moduleToDivisorZeroPresheafApp K U)
    (moduleToDivisorZeroPresheafApp_bijective K U)

noncomputable def coordinateDivisorV₀Equiv
    (h₀ : divisorSections K (n • D.coordinateWeilDivisor (K := K)) D.V₀ =
      Submodule.map (mulByUnit K (D.coordinateUnit⁻¹ ^ n)).toLinearMap
        (divisorSections K 0 D.V₀)) :
    Γ(Y, D.V₀) ≃ₗ[K]
      divisorSections K (n • D.coordinateWeilDivisor (K := K)) D.V₀ :=
  ((zeroSectionsEquiv (K := K) D.V₀).trans
    ((mulByUnit K (D.coordinateUnit⁻¹ ^ n)).submoduleMap
      (divisorSections K 0 D.V₀))).trans
    (LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ h₀.symm)

noncomputable def coordinateDivisorV₁Equiv
    (h₁ : divisorSections K (n • D.coordinateWeilDivisor (K := K)) D.V₁ =
      divisorSections K 0 D.V₁) :
    Γ(Y, D.V₁) ≃ₗ[K]
      divisorSections K (n • D.coordinateWeilDivisor (K := K)) D.V₁ :=
  (zeroSectionsEquiv (K := K) D.V₁).trans
    (LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ h₁.symm)

noncomputable def coordinateDivisorOverlapEquiv
    (h₁₀ : divisorSections K (n • D.coordinateWeilDivisor (K := K)) (D.V₀ ⊓ D.V₁) =
      divisorSections K 0 (D.V₀ ⊓ D.V₁)) :
    Γ(Y, D.V₀ ⊓ D.V₁) ≃ₗ[K]
      divisorSections K (n • D.coordinateWeilDivisor (K := K)) (D.V₀ ⊓ D.V₁) :=
  (zeroSectionsEquiv (K := K) (D.V₀ ⊓ D.V₁)).trans
    (LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ h₁₀.symm)

noncomputable def coordinateDivisorDomEquiv
    (h₀ : divisorSections K (n • D.coordinateWeilDivisor (K := K)) D.V₀ =
      Submodule.map (mulByUnit K (D.coordinateUnit⁻¹ ^ n)).toLinearMap
        (divisorSections K 0 D.V₀))
    (h₁ : divisorSections K (n • D.coordinateWeilDivisor (K := K)) D.V₁ =
      divisorSections K 0 D.V₁) :
    (Γ(Y, D.V₀) × Γ(Y, D.V₁)) ≃ₗ[K]
      ((Y.divisorSheaf K (n • D.coordinateWeilDivisor (K := K))).obj.obj (op D.V₀) ×
        (Y.divisorSheaf K (n • D.coordinateWeilDivisor (K := K))).obj.obj (op D.V₁)) :=
  (coordinateDivisorV₀Equiv D n h₀).prodCongr
    (coordinateDivisorV₁Equiv D n h₁)

noncomputable def coordinateDivisorCodEquiv
    (h₁₀ : divisorSections K (n • D.coordinateWeilDivisor (K := K)) (D.V₀ ⊓ D.V₁) =
      divisorSections K 0 (D.V₀ ⊓ D.V₁)) :
    Γ(Y, D.V₀ ⊓ D.V₁) ≃ₗ[K]
      (Y.divisorSheaf K (n • D.coordinateWeilDivisor (K := K))).obj.obj
        (op (D.V₀ ⊓ D.V₁)) :=
  coordinateDivisorOverlapEquiv D n h₁₀

lemma coordinateDivisorV₀Equiv_coe
    (h₀ : divisorSections K (n • D.coordinateWeilDivisor (K := K)) D.V₀ =
      Submodule.map (mulByUnit K (D.coordinateUnit⁻¹ ^ n)).toLinearMap
        (divisorSections K 0 D.V₀)) (s : Γ(Y, D.V₀)) :
    ((coordinateDivisorV₀Equiv D n h₀ s :
      divisorSections K (n • D.coordinateWeilDivisor (K := K)) D.V₀) : Y.functionField) =
      ((D.coordinateUnit⁻¹ ^ n : Y.functionFieldˣ) : Y.functionField) *
        ((moduleToDivisorZeroPresheafApp K D.V₀ s : divisorSections K 0 D.V₀) :
          Y.functionField) := by
  rfl

lemma coordinateDivisorV₁Equiv_coe
    (h₁ : divisorSections K (n • D.coordinateWeilDivisor (K := K)) D.V₁ =
      divisorSections K 0 D.V₁) (s : Γ(Y, D.V₁)) :
    ((coordinateDivisorV₁Equiv D n h₁ s :
      divisorSections K (n • D.coordinateWeilDivisor (K := K)) D.V₁) : Y.functionField) =
      ((moduleToDivisorZeroPresheafApp K D.V₁ s : divisorSections K 0 D.V₁) :
        Y.functionField) := by
  rfl

lemma coordinateDivisorCodEquiv_coe
    (h₁₀ : divisorSections K (n • D.coordinateWeilDivisor (K := K)) (D.V₀ ⊓ D.V₁) =
      divisorSections K 0 (D.V₀ ⊓ D.V₁)) (s : Γ(Y, D.V₀ ⊓ D.V₁)) :
    ((coordinateDivisorCodEquiv D n h₁₀ s :
      divisorSections K (n • D.coordinateWeilDivisor (K := K)) (D.V₀ ⊓ D.V₁)) :
        Y.functionField) =
      ((moduleToDivisorZeroPresheafApp K (D.V₀ ⊓ D.V₁) s :
        divisorSections K 0 (D.V₀ ⊓ D.V₁)) : Y.functionField) := by

private lemma divisorVal_coordinateModuleDiff
